event.title: Massive $6.3 Billion Hack Targets Binance Cryptocurrency Exchange
event.canonical_title: Massive $6.3 Billion Hack Targets Binance Cryptocurrency Exchange
event.summary: Hackers have stolen approximately $6.3 billion from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, marking it as potentially the largest crypto heist in history. Analysts suggest that the attack may have been orchestrated by North Korean hackers. In response to the breach, Binance has stated that it will cover the losses and has frozen about half of the stolen assets to mitigate the impact on users.

timeline.title: Binance Investigates Major Security Issue Affecting $6.3 Billion
timeline.summary: Binance, the largest cryptocurrency exchange, is investigating a potential security issue that may have impacted approximately $6.3 billion. The company's founder indicated that the situation resembles a hack, although it has not been confirmed that any funds were stolen. Binance's teams are actively working to address the issue.
key_facts: Binance is investigating a potential security issue.
The founder suggested it looks like a hack.
